notes: Which club field hockey teams the players on the tracked varsity rosters (the 43 schools of the four leagues swept on 2026-10-03, the schools of the six Eastern Athletic League teams swept on 2026-10-04, and the schools of the 53 Southern California teams swept on 2026-10-06) play (or played) for, joined to data/rosters.json on team slug + MaxPreps athleteId. Only players on those rosters are named (varsity rows; rows the overlay marks JV are out of scope). A club's own roster lists many more players, who are not named here: the club's roster pages are linked instead.

The linking rule is the one data/rosters-enrichment.json uses for recruiting profiles, applied to clubs: a public page must name the player and a field hockey club, and either name the player's high school, or give a class year that agrees with the roster grade together with a location in the school's half of the state, Northern or Southern California (the player's hometown, or a club or team based there; "CA" alone, or a hometown with no state, is not enough). A class year that disagrees with the roster grade rules a match out; a name alone never makes one. Lacrosse, soccer and ice hockey clubs do not count, and neither do social-media posts.

Every affiliation of the 2026-10-03 sweep was checked twice on that day: a checker re-opened each source and applied the rule, then an independent refuter re-opened the sources and tried to break it (another person of the same name, a quote not on the page, a misidentified club, a class year that disagrees, a stale listing). Only affiliations that survived both are in that sweep. Each source keeps its URL, kind and a verbatim quote (several quotes from one page are joined with ' … '); every source names the player or is the player's own profile page, so a club's about page used only to confirm a former club name is not kept. basis says what the match rests on.

status: current = the source reflects the 2025-26 or 2026-27 club seasons (dated August 2025 or later, a club's current-players page, or a live recruiting profile that lists the club); past = dated earlier, an alumni list, or a club the player's own page lists for earlier years; unknown = listed with no usable date, or a newer page names another club for the player. asOf is the date or season the source gives. confidence: high = one first-hand page names player, club and school (or is the player's own profile); medium = the match rests on a club roster's class-year heading plus the club's location, on a team nickname standing for the school, or on a single self-reported line.

clubs[] are the youth field hockey clubs around the 43 schools of the four leagues swept on 2026-10-03 (San Francisco, the Peninsula, the South Bay, the East Bay, Marin and the Central Coast), plus any club a rostered player is tied to, plus three clubs met near the six EAL teams' schools on 2026-10-04 (D-City in Davis and Roseville FHC, region sacramento; Chico Hotshots, region north-state). Each record was read from the club's own site on its checkedOn date (2026-10-03, or 2026-10-04 for those three) and names no individual. Clubs that run only adult teams or only K-5 clinics are left out unless a rostered player is tied to them. Twelve Southern California clubs were added on 2026-10-06 (notes[8]). Only the six areas named above and the five Southern California areas of notes[8] were searched for clubs (lib/clubs.ts SEARCHED_REGIONS); the Sacramento area and the North State were not, so other clubs may be based there. capturedAt is the day of the first sweep; a later record carries its own checkedOn.

The schools of the six Eastern Athletic League teams (Bella Vista, Chico, Corning, Davis, Lassen, Pleasant Valley) were swept on 2026-10-04 with the same rule, using: the NFHCA 2025 and 2026 high school watchlists, the NCFHA youth directory (https://www.ncfha.org/youth), SportsRecruits profile slugs, NCSA, fhcollegepath.com classes 2026-2028, MAX Field Hockey, the club-teams block of the 95 EAL rows' MaxPreps career pages (Corning's roster has no rows), and the sites of the clubs it met. It found eight ties for five players. At Davis: Kira Kelly, Kate Loscutoff and Amelia Zedonis to NorCal Impact (the 2026-08-27 watchlist, current), Kira Kelly and Amelia Zedonis to D-City (the 2025-08-28 watchlist; unknown, because the newer list names NorCal Impact) and Kate Loscutoff to D-City (her own NCSA profile, 2023 and 2024; past). At Pleasant Valley: Lilah Letcher and Kate Panighetti to Chico Hotshots (the club-teams block of each one's own MaxPreps career page, entries last modified 2026-09-29 and 2026-05-20; current). Each was confirmed by two independent checks that re-opened its source. Three club records were added for the clubs the sweep met: D-City, Roseville FHC and Chico Hotshots. No EAL player is tied to Roseville FHC: one name on its Summer 2026 league archive matches a Bella Vista row, but the page gives no school or class year, and a name alone never makes a match.

Recall is partial. Sources searched: the NCFHA and BAFHA club directories, every club's own site, SportsRecruits athlete and organization pages, NCSA, Hudl, the club-teams block on each rostered player's MaxPreps career page (all 716 varsity rows of the 43 schools swept on 2026-10-03, and the 95 EAL rows on 2026-10-04), the NFHCA 2025 and 2026 high school watchlists, MAX Field Hockey club and event pages, Stick Together (sticktogetherfh.com), the Gilroy Dispatch and other local and school news, and USA Field Hockey lists. A name on a club roster with no school or class year was not enough; Fly FHC's team-roster page, which is behind a captcha, could not be re-read and none of its names are here. A player with no public page that meets the rule is not listed, whatever club they play for. See docs/DATA-SOURCES.md.

On 2026-10-05 every recruiting profile linked from data/rosters-enrichment.json, data/commits.json or this file was re-read for the clubs it lists: 74 SportsRecruits pages (read in a browser, since their CLUB and TEAMS blocks are rendered by script and are not in the page's HTML), 36 NCSA pages and 51 Hudl pages (Hudl lists school teams only). It added 14 ties for 13 players, all to clubs already in clubs[]. Left out: three Los Gatos players whose pages list NorCal Impact (and one, SF Hawks) are on JV rows; Nexus and other program teams ('U18 Sydney', 'Oranje U19', 'Futures/Nexus') are not clubs; lacrosse and soccer clubs (STEPS California, ADVNC, Verve, San Francisco Glens) do not count; and Kate Loscutoff's 2025 season with Sacramento Hockey Academy is not tied, because the club has no record here. Each new tie rests on the player's own profile, and each was re-checked by an independent refuter that re-opened the page, which names the club, the class year and (for all but Sophie Dhillon) the school; status follows the rule above, a live profile listing the club with no end date counting as current.

The schools of the 53 Southern California teams (the Sunset, City, North and Metro teams and the five Southern Section independents: 842 varsity rows, nine teams with none) were swept on 2026-10-06 with the same rule, a Southern California location standing for a Northern California one. Clubs were found in USA Field Hockey's club finder, the SoCal Field Hockey Federation's and the San Diego Field Hockey Association's club lists, the NFHCA 2025 and 2026 watchlists, the California Cup 2026 standings, FieldLevel's California club list and MAX Field Hockey, and each record was read from the club's own site, then re-read by a second check: RUSH, Coastal Clash, Myto and the San Marcos Knights (region san-diego), the Ventura County Red Devils and Bulldogs (ventura), West Coast Riptide and the LA Tigers (los-angeles), and the Royals, the Huntington Beach Surfers, the SoCal Strikers and the Orange County Field Hockey Club (orange-county). None was found in the Inland Empire, and Poway Mystix's site could not be reached, so it has no record. HTC's region moved from elsewhere to san-diego, since every HTC California program trains in La Jolla or Chula Vista. Ties came from the watchlists, MAX Field Hockey's club, school and athlete pages, SportsRecruits athlete and club pages (rendered in a browser), RUSH's player directory, the club-teams block of all 842 rows' MaxPreps career pages, and the club lists on the players' own NCSA and FieldLevel profiles. 75 ties for 67 players were kept (HTC 28, RUSH 15, Myto 15, Coastal Clash 7, VCRD 6, Knights FHC 3, West Coast Riptide 1). Each was re-opened by a checker and, separately, by a refuter told to break it, and only ties both kept are here. "Rush Devils" is a joint squad of RUSH and VCRD players (the SoCal FHF's NCC 2026 pages), so a page that names only "Rush Devils" ties a player to neither club: a tie to RUSH or VCRD rests on a page that names that club. Left out: two players (Thousand Oaks, Harvard-Westlake) whose only club is "Rush Devils", a nickname page that names no school, two common names whose pages give no school or hometown, a MAX "Rush" listing for a player every other page ties to VCRD, and a bare "SF Hawks U19" team card on a San Diego player's profile.
